bio_en: Hakob Abrahamian, revolutionary name Vard-Manushak, was born in Adapazari on 2 April 1873, the son of Abraham Astvatsaturian, and studied at the local Nersesian school. Losing his father young, he worked as a tailor while educating himself so thoroughly that people took him for a university graduate. In 1895 he emigrated to America and joined the ARF. After visiting the 1900 Paris exhibition he went to Izmir on a dangerous party mission, defying a prelate who had betrayed revolutionaries to the authorities.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Text truncated; outcome of his mission and death not read.
